# avd_portal_publish.ps1

<!-- Generated by scripts/Update-BrainDocs.ps1 from the code. Do not edit; edit the code and regenerate. -->

Publishes a copy of the assessment portal into your own subscription (optional), or removes it.

You don't need this to run an assessment: the portal on GitHub Pages works for everyone. Publish a copy when you want it in your own subscription, for a fork, or pinned to a release (docs/assessment-portal-spec.md, phase 4; the same pattern as the landing zone's decision 0017). 1. Checks the subscription's allowed-locations policies against the host's region before it creates anything. 2. Creates the resource group (-ResourceGroupName, tagged purpose=avd-assessment-portal) holding one of: -Hosting StaticWebApp (default) Azure Static Web Apps, Free plan ($0), in one of centralus, eastus2, westus2, westeurope, eastasia. Uploaded with the Static Web Apps CLI (npx, pinned version). -Hosting Storage A storage account's static website in -Location (cents a month). No npm, no deployment token, no app consent; account keys are off and you upload with your own sign-in. Anyone with the URL can open it. 3. Uploads site/portal and site/assets with a portal-config.js naming the repo and the tag or commit every command clones and checks out (-RepoUrl, -Ref; default: this checkout's origin and commit). 4. Prints the portal's URL. -RequireSignIn (StaticWebApp only) locks every page to users you invite to the 'operator' role (up to 25 on the Free plan) and invites you. The Free plan's sign-in accepts any Microsoft account, so signing in alone is never enough. Single-tenant sign-in, IP restrictions and private endpoints need the Standard plan (about $9 a month): your choice in the Azure portal, never this script's. The Static Web Apps deployment token never leaves this process: it goes to the CLI in an environment variable, is cleared, and is reset after the upload so the token this shell saw is dead. -Remove deletes the resource group, and only one this script made (the purpose tag). The page holds no secrets and pasted output never leaves the browser. Writes to Azure: the resource group, the site or storage account, and (Storage) a Storage Blob Data Contributor assignment for you on that account. Runs in Azure Cloud Shell (PowerShell) at the repo root, with Az.Accounts, and Az.Storage for -Hosting Storage. Uses ARM REST through Invoke-AzRestMethod. Personal project, not for production use. Provided as is, without warranty of any kind (MIT License, see LICENSE). Not affiliated with the author's employer, with Liquidware or with Microsoft.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `-Location` | string | no |  | The resource group's region and, for Storage, the account's. |
| `-Hosting` | string | no | `'StaticWebApp'` |  |
| `-StaticWebAppLocation` | string | no | `''` | Empty: -Location when Static Web Apps is offered there, else the first one the policies allow. |
| `-ResourceGroupName` | string | no | `'rg-avd-assessment-portal'` |  |
| `-RequireSignIn` | switch | no |  |  |
| `-RepoUrl` | string | no |  | The repo the portal's commands clone, and the tag or commit they check out. Empty: this checkout's. |
| `-Ref` | string | no |  |  |
| `-Subscription` | string | no |  | A subscription name or ID. Empty: the current one. |
| `-Remove` | switch | no |  |  |

## Examples

```powershell
./avd_portal_publish.ps1 -Location eastus2
```
```powershell
./avd_portal_publish.ps1 -Location northcentralus -Hosting Storage
```
```powershell
./avd_portal_publish.ps1 -Location eastus2 -RequireSignIn -RepoUrl https://github.com/contoso/avd-current-state -Ref v1.2.0
```
```powershell
./avd_portal_publish.ps1 -Remove
```
